name: Build macOS DMG

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*.*.*']
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build-macos-dmg:
    runs-on: macos-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version-file: .python-version
          cache: pip

      - name: Cache pip dependencies
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/.cache/pip
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-pip-${{ hashFiles('**/requirements.txt') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-pip-

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt

      - name: Set up Swift (if needed)
        uses: swift-actions/setup-swift@v2
        with:
          swift-version: 5.10

      - name: Import code signing certificates
        if: env.CODE_SIGN_CERT_BASE64 != '' && env.CODE_SIGN_CERT_PASSWORD != '' && env.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD != ''
        env:
          CODE_SIGN_CERT_BASE64: ${{ secrets.CODE_SIGN_CERT_BASE64 }}
          CODE_SIGN_CERT_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.CODE_SIGN_CERT_PASSWORD }}
          KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
        uses: apple-actions/import-codesign-certs@v2
        with:
          keychain: build.keychain
          create-keychain: true
          keychain-password: ${{ env.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
          p12-filepath: build.p12
          p12-file-base64: ${{ env.CODE_SIGN_CERT_BASE64 }}
          p12-password: ${{ env.CODE_SIGN_CERT_PASSWORD }}

      - name: Build universal DMG
        env:
          KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD: ${{ secrets.KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD }}
          CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY: ${{ secrets.CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY }}
        run: |
          # Ensure the keychain is the default for signing
          security list-keychains -s build.keychain
          security unlock-keychain -p "$KEYCHAIN_PASSWORD" build.keychain
          # Build the DMG (Makefile should handle universal binaries)
          make dmg

      - name: Upload DMG artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: sshpilot-dmg
          path: dist/*.dmg
